ayahOccurrences.text: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: حُقُبًا is in the derivative form: حُقُب
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/ق/ب   ḥ–q–b retention of urine; to store, to collect; saddlebag; long space of time, year, span of eighty years.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
حُقُب ḥuqub and أَحْقَابٌ ʾaḥqāb.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
حُقُب ḥuqub [either a variant of sing. n. حُقْبٌ ḥuqb or its plural] a year/years

(18:60) لاَ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّى أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا I will not desist [from journeying] until I reach the place where the two seas meet, even if I go on for ages.

entries.label: أَحْقَابٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَحْقَابٌ ʾaḥqāb [pl. of n. حُقْبٌ ḥuqb] long period of time, years, eighty years

(78:23) لاَبِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا to stay in it for a long, long time.
